subject: Access attribution & export format — follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharbor.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: discovery - access attribution & residency

Jonas / Lauren,

Thanks for the call today. As discussed, Blue Harbor's security and privacy team needs a one-off export of access logs that answers "who accessed what and when" for a scoped set of resources. High-level asks:

- Export window: last 90 days (we used 2026-04-01 as a reference during the call)
- Attribution: include both service accounts and end-user actors, with actor type flagged (service/user)
- Context: action (read/write/delete), resource_type, resource_id, request_id, and HTTP status where applicable
- Network: source IP and geolocation/region for each access event
- Residency: confirm whether exports can be generated from a US-only data plane (data residency requirement)
- PII: guidance on how user identifiers appear and options for pseudonymizing or hashing emails/SSNs

Can you confirm the CSV schema you can provide, the maximum file size you can produce in one export, and an estimated delivery timeline? Our compliance team would like a small sample (5-10 rows) first to validate the mapping before we request the full 90-day export.

Thanks — if you can send the sample and a short schema PDF that would be ideal.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Security Lead, Blue Harbor Financial
security@blueharbor.com

Attachment referenced: call_notes_20260630.txt

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery - access attribution & residency

Aisha — thanks for the clear summary and the items you called out on the call. Quick update and what we can deliver as a first pass: 

1) Sample export: attached a 10-row CSV (access_attribution_sample.csv) and a short schema doc (redwood_logging_schema_v1.pdf). The CSV includes the following columns:
   - timestamp (ISO8601)
   - actor_id (internal user id)
   - actor_type (user | service)
   - resource_type
   - resource_id
   - action (read/write/delete)
   - request_id
   - ip_address
   - geo_region
   - http_status

2) PII handling: by default we do not export cleartext emails or SSNs. actor_id is a stable internal identifier scoped to your tenant. Options we can offer:
   - pseudonymized actor_id (hash of the original user id)
   - provide a separate mapping file that links actor_id -> email (delivered under additional controls)
   - redaction on request (strip any email address fields entirely)

3) Residency & generation: we can create the export from a US-only control plane for your tenant. Exports are stored temporarily (see retention notes below) and delivered via a secure S3 presigned URL.

4) Size & timeline: for a 90-day window for your account we estimate a single CSV export ~2-4GB depending on activity. We can split into chunked files if preferred. We can produce the sample now; full export target: 3 business days after scope sign-off (subject to rate limiting / queuing).

Next steps: please confirm (A) whether you want pseudonymized actor_id or the separate mapping, (B) NDJSON vs CSV preference, and (C) whether Blue Harbor requires any additional redaction rules. Once confirmed we'll queue an export ticket (SOW BH-4821-EXPORT) and loop in Markus to produce the data.

Attaching sample and schema as discussed.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: access_attribution_sample.csv, redwood_logging_schema_v1.pdf

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharbor.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Blue Harbor Security Team <security@blueharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery - access attribution & residency

Jonas — received the sample, thank you. A few clarifications from our side after a quick pass: 

- Format: we'd prefer newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) in addition to CSV for easier ingestion into our SIEM. Can you include both export formats?
- PII: do not include cleartext email addresses in the export. We prefer a pseudonymized actor_id plus a reversible mapping file delivered separately under an encrypted bucket with MFA.
- Timezone: ensure timestamps are in UTC and include offset if possible.
- Retention snapshot: we will need a snapshot export for the 90-day window initially; for ongoing monitoring, we may request a rolling 180-day archive — can you outline options and estimated storage cost?
- SLA: can you confirm 3 business days for the full export once we sign scope? We need internal sign-off from legal/compliance.

If you can confirm NDJSON + CSV, pseudonymized actor_id + encrypted mapping file, and the 3-business-day target we'll move forward with scope sign-off. Please copy our legal contact (legal@blueharbor.com) when you send the mapping plan.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Security Lead, Blue Harbor Financial

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Blue Harbor export — plan and owners

Team — copying the thread for internal alignment. Summary and action items: 

- Deliverables: sample (done), full export in CSV + NDJSON, pseudonymized actor_id + encrypted mapping file delivered to an MFA-protected S3 URL.
- Timeline: target 3 business days after BH signs scope. Jonas to confirm scope with Aisha today.
- Engineering: Markus to generate export job and confirm chunking strategy (max 1GB per file).
- Legal / Compliance: Monica to draft the minimal access controls for the mapping file delivery and sign-off language for the SOW (BH-4821-EXPORT).
- Cost: estimate storage and egress; include in the SOW.

Markus — please review and confirm you can produce both formats and the encrypted mapping delivery method. I'll prepare the SOW template and a short runbook for the delivery process.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
